subject: New native browser implementation review
result: Read-only review of desktop/cradle/src-tauri/src/browser.rs, BrowserSurface.tsx, windows.rs, main.rs, capabilities/main-window.json and material_protocol.rs found: address-bar origin can be spoofed after failed/cancelled navigation because requested URL is published before commit; browser reconciliation removes registry rows before close and aborts on first failure, orphaning live webviews; missing child webviews leave permanent stale Session rows; attach publishes host ownership before reparent/show succeeds and wrong-host controls silently return success; navigation callbacks lack generation ordering. Cargo check, frontend build and diff whitespace passed. Findings sent to parent; no edits.
